components.name: ICS-VEX Reverse SBOM Builder
components.description: Reverse-builds a CycloneDX SBOM-CVE per ICS device from the CISA ICS-CERT advisory corpus.

component.name: Siemens SINEC INS
component.description: ICS/OT asset 'SINEC INS' by Siemens, reverse-built from CISA ICS-CERT advisory icsa-24-319-08.

components.name: OpenSSL
components.description: TLS/SSL and general-purpose cryptography library. Handles the device's secure communication channels and certificate processing.

components.name: Apache Tomcat
components.description: Servlet container serving the web-based supervisory client.

components.name: OpenSSH
components.description: SSH server/client used for remote management and secure file transfer.

components.name: SQLite
components.description: Embedded database engine for alarm history, trend buffers, and local configuration storage.
